name: Flip 7

rounds.endCondition: Round in which at least one player reaches 200 points; highest total then wins

categories.label: Sum of Number cards
categories.hint: Add the values of your Number cards in line (0 is worth nothing). Enter 0 if you busted.

categories.label: x2 card in line
categories.hint: Doubles the Number-card sum only (before adding +modifiers). Adds an extra copy of the sum.

categories.label: +2 to +10 modifier cards
categories.hint: Sum of +2/+4/+6/+8/+10 cards in line; scored even without Number cards. Enter 0 if busted.

categories.label: Flip 7 bonus (7 unique Number cards)
categories.labelVi: Thưởng Flip 7 (7 lá số khác nhau)
categories.hint: +15 if you flipped 7 different Number cards.

tiebreakers.description: Rulebook text read does not define a tie at 200+; play another round if tied for most points (common ruling, unverified).

notes: family: rounds (press-your-luck; round scores accumulate). Score a player's round: Number sum, x2 first, then add modifiers, then +15 for Flip 7; a busted player scores 0 that round. Enter one scoring per round. Game ends at end of round where anyone has >=200; most points wins. Tie handling not found in rulebook text.
